---
title: Interactive Rmd
output: html_document
runtime: shiny #this is what removes the knit option; interactive widgets
---
  
```{r, echo = FALSE}
numericInput("n", #defines a widget- interface
"How many cars?", 5)

renderTable({ #runs when n changes
head(cars, input$n) #cars is a built in dataframe. then return n rows. input is just any interface
})
```
